notes.title: Today we are going to remove 7 Legacy Steam achievements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/d476cf34409cb286d72fd8dfdcad8230d6ddd1c3.jpg
Dear MFL Steam Community,

Today we are going to remove 7 Legacy Steam achievements, specifically the following:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/c2edf0c29f0816bc5a298b7242afe8fe9bd8251e.jpg Blitzburgh Steelheads
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/45112f83e47e311092d7140ba5e2e04213114d9c.jpg Cardinal Sins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/a8194002a6eb3115c10b51e1934cced2e61684b0.jpg Grim Bay Attackers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/adc85a0a026b5c54f19d79fbad355d4d8440cd2e.jpg Leaveland Burns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/4f2615e86ddcb867d826d1755b97a4584cb03f4c.jpg Malice Hellboys
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/2e8d16f6e8441c4160a3e64e1141c96c0960cc2e.jpg Mile High Chronic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/a8194002a6eb3115c10b51e1934cced2e61684b0.jpg Motor City Maniacs


Since our game's initial release back in 2017, we’ve kept these 7 achievements to honor those who achieved them. However, times change, and so do games.
With the release of Dynasty Edition in 2018, we made significant updates, including the unlocking of all parody teams - a feature requested by the passionate MFL Steam community. While these achievements have remained in the game, they have lost relevance since they cannot be achieved, and many members of our vibrant community have expressed their desire for their removal - since it is not possible for them to complete all the achievements 100%. This sentiment is not limited to a small group; it represents the majority of players who now outnumber those early achievers.
We understand that change can be challenging, and no matter what direction we take, some members of our community may be disappointed. For this, we sincerely apologize. Our aim is to ensure that Mutant Football League continues to be a welcoming and enjoyable experience for both new and longtime players.
That's why we've made the decision to remove these achievements, effective immediately after the publication of this announcement. We believe this change will better accommodate the evolving landscape of MFL and provide a fair playing field for everyone.
We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to our early players who achieved these milestones. Your dedication has been integral to the growth and success of Mutant Football League. We hope you understand that this decision has been made with the best interests of the entire community in mind.
As always, we value your feedback and engagement. Please feel free to reach out if you have any questions or concerns. We are committed to making Mutant Football League an even more enjoyable and inclusive experience for all.

 Also, as we’ve promised earlier here (check the thread), we’re preparing to release MFL - Complete Bundle which will include base and all DLC for the game. Please check the MFL store page after October 10th.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30716534/23d5d4589e7b1e0ae1d0a3160adda49eed831ee2.jpg

Thank you for being a part of our fantastic community, and we look forward to seeing you on the gridiron!

The Mutant Football League Team

notes.title: 03.08.2019 Steam Summer Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/bda35e70bf8584e1902afb77d0f9c04f69b7c100.png

Features

      Roster updates to reflect the 2019 football season (we will have another update after final cuts - late September 2019).
      Added custom camera for Onside Kick. 
      Added camera shakes after brutal tackles. 
      Mayhem Bowl game mode is reintroduced to the game. 
      Now players can turn on/off Arena Hazards, Weather, Dirty Tricks and Game Spectate in all game modes. Game Spectate is set to OFF by default.
      Added new Leaderboards categories in the Dynasty game mode (Funds, Point Scored, Passing Yards, Receiving Yards, Rushing Yards, Interceptions, Kills, 2018 Season). 
      Added Leaderboard for Online Game mode (Wins, Loses, Games Played). 
      Now players can turn on/off notification "Someone is looking for an online Match", this option is set to ON by default.


Changes & Improvements

      Balancing and Economy improvements in Dynasty game mode. 
      Balancing AI difficulty. 
      Now AI most likely will be trying to tie the game in the end of 4th quarter. 
      Now in Dynasty, Custom Playbook all Formations are sorted in order of the addition. 
      Now Sonic Blast Dirty Trick cannot be intercepted. 
      Now RB's and QB's are more sensitive to the Catch rating. 
      Now Smack talk aka pre-game speech will be shown in Halftime as well. 
      Now Ref will be more inclined to call Pass Interference when the TARGETED receiver is interfered with while the ball is in the air. 
      Improvement of the Dive and Hurdle animations for Demon model. 
      General improvement of stability.
      Various GUI improvements and text typo fixes. 


Bug-fixes

      Fixed bug causing incorrect behavior of the Killbot (robot) model after death or explosion. 
      Fixed bug preventing newly acquired Line Bashers to appear on the field despite Depth Chart position or manual substitution. 
      Fixed bug preventing newly acquired player from being a starting player. 
      Fixed bug that caused Depth Chart UI glitches in the Playoffs mode if it was launched right after Dynasty game mode. 
      Fixed bug causing Line Bashers' Intelligence does not affect / unlock of more defense slots for Formations and Plays in Defense Playbook.
      Fixed bug causing AI to use Time Warp Dirty Trick upon beginning of the 2nd half to return time on the end of the 3rd quarter. 
      Fixed bug when Burn Returners weren't able to collect XP. 
      Fixed various miscellaneous bugs. 


Please, be advised that due to number of changes in Dynasty game mode and roster update, we're strongly recommending to start new Dynasty run after update. 

Thank you for reports and feedback!

notes.title: Answering some questions...
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/f00631fcee4177e611aa740906a95c5f471a26bc.jpg

Hey MFL Steam community,

Mutant Football League: Dynasty Edition launches on October 30th. 

Since you’ve been with us and supported us and bought the original you will receive Dynasty Pack DLC for FREE.
 
Please be advised that this opportunity will only be available for players who already own MFL when the Dynasty Pack DLC is released.
 
HOW DO I GET IT?

Shortly after the launch Dynasty Pack DLC will be automatically applied to the game after update.

WHAT DOES IT INCLUDE?


    Dynasty Pack – Become the coach and GM of your favorite MFL team. Win multiple championships to become the league’s next Dynasty. Includes player XP, roster management, team salary caps, custom playbooks, player trades, free agent signings and multiple season gameplay!


IS IT FREE?

Yes, it’s free.

We will be giving the Dynasty Pack DLC away FREE to all existing STEAM owners!
Please be advised that this opportunity will only be available for players who already own MFL when the Dynasty Pack DLC is released.
 
Thank you again for all your support throughout our development. We hope you’ve enjoyed the game up to this point and with the Dynasty Edition we think you’re going to enjoy it even more.


Best wishes,
The MFL Team

notes.title: New Release Date is October 30, 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/b1283e32944494e4be63432717ba498b0bf51ce8.jpg
Hey MFL Steam community,

We've New Release Date for MUTANT Football League: Dynasty Edition. The game is launching October 30th in North American Retailers!

Thanks comicbook and Gaming Cypher for spreding the word.

From last time when we've officially spoke about release date in June 13th our plans have changed, but fear not most significant details are staying true to original post:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/529520/announcements/detail/1657768916932160920


So what have chnaged?
We've new release plan for all 3 DLCs - they'll be released simultaneously on October 30th:

    Dynasty Pack – Become the coach and GM of your favorite MFL team. Win multiple championships to become the league’s next Dynasty. Includes player XP, roster management, team salary caps, custom playbooks, player trades, free agent signings and multiple season gameplay!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/1e9e1c59fba5bd264a6c0bf90c29b3a4e3ea1ad1.jpg
    Demonic Legion Pack – Includes the brand new Hell-Spawned Demons species, two additional devilish Dirty Tricks, two brand new teams, and their corresponding stadiums!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/3d5f58caaeb67c45cf309259d6e445e30c1e2df4.jpg
    Werewolf Rampage Pack – Includes the brand new Rampaging Werewolves species, two additional ferocious Dirty Tricks, two brand new teams, and their corresponding stadiums!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/1b900fc9155b2499139439397f9e1e2b09607881.jpg


So what stays same as before?
[olist]
 We're still want to thank all or you who have supported us by purchasing Mutant Football League, we will be giving the Dynasty Pack DLC away FREE to all existing Steam owners!
 TIMED exclusive content will be release digitally in ~3 months  after retail release.
[/olist]

So for now, that's all news. Stay tuned for future announcements, events and see you in a BETA Dynasty!


Best wishes,
The MFL Team

 Max quarter time is 7
 Improved UI in pre-snap for offense team (defense is in progress)
 You can check your routes before kicks too

notes.title: MFL Longer Range Plans…
notes.content:
One of the things the MFL Team has tried hard to do is to involve our community with our future plans for the product early on. 
First, none of this happens if the game is not successful. You can help us make the game successful by promoting it through your social sites, by writing reviews and streaming.
Here is the direction we are heading over the next 6 months providing the game can generate enough revenue to allow us to do this:

Ports:

Windows 10 Version
Develop a Switch Version
Develop a Mobile Version
Apple / Mac - TBD

Game Enhancements / Expansions:

There are 2 routes we can go. One is to keep improving the game and move it towards a more competitive E-Sports structure, by allowing players to construct their own teams, rosters, playbooks and arena hazards with a balanced ratings system. The other is to create a Franchise / Story Mode where we can bring our characters to life. Our community has requested both of these major features over the last year. Both are solid features and directions for the game to go.

Initially, we want to create tools that allow Players to create their own content. Once that is in place we will be looking seriously into creating a story mode. This would be completely different than anything you’ve ever experienced in a sports game before. However, a story / franchise mode requires a deep narrative and universe creation, which requires time, the right people working on it and serious money to develop. We do want to develop this feature, but the property needs to prove itself worthy of this kind of investment first. 

For the immediate future we plan to focus on the following:

Enhancements / Features:

 More Species (Demons, Werewolves, etc.)
 Online enhancements (co-op, 4 player, etc.).
 Improved Tackling Animations
 Season Improvements
 More Dirty Tricks
 Community Request / Feature development
 Graphical improvements


Sandbox Creation Tools:

 Team Editor (create your own team, name team, team colors, etc.)
 Play Editor (create your own plays and playbook)
 Arena Editor (name your arena, choose your field, hazards, etc.)
 Player Editor (Name players, pick species types, add ratings – with a balanced rating system – everyone has the same number of ratings points and how you allocate them amongst your players is up to you)
 League Structure with competitive leader boards

notes.title: MFL Longer Range Plans…
notes.content:
One of the things the MFL Team has tried hard to do is to involve our community with our future plans for the product early on. 
First, none of this happens if the game is not successful. You can help us make the game successful by promoting it through your social sites, by writing reviews and streaming.
Here is the direction we are heading over the next 6 months providing the game can generate enough revenue to allow us to do this:

Ports:

Windows 10 Version
Develop a Switch Version
Develop a Mobile Version
Apple / Mac - TBD

Game Enhancements / Expansions:

There are 2 routes we can go. One is to keep improving the game and move it towards a more competitive E-Sports structure, by allowing players to construct their own teams, rosters, playbooks and arena hazards with a balanced ratings system. The other is to create a Franchise / Story Mode where we can bring our characters to life. Our community has requested both of these major features over the last year. Both are solid features and directions for the game to go.

Initially, we want to create tools that allow Players to create their own content. Once that is in place we will be looking seriously into creating a story mode. This would be completely different than anything you’ve ever experienced in a sports game before. However, a story / franchise mode requires a deep narrative and universe creation, which requires time, the right people working on it and serious money to develop. We do want to develop this feature, but the property needs to prove itself worthy of this kind of investment first. 

For the immediate future we plan to focus on the following:

Enhancements / Features:

 More Species (Demons, Werewolves, etc.)
 Online enhancements (co-op, 4 player, etc.).
 Improved Tackling Animations
 Season Improvements
 More Dirty Tricks
 Community Request / Feature development
 Graphical improvements


Sandbox Creation Tools:

 Team Editor (create your own team, name team, team colors, etc.)
 Play Editor (create your own plays and playbook)
 Arena Editor (name your arena, choose your field, hazards, etc.)
 Player Editor (Name players, pick species types, add ratings – with a balanced rating system – everyone has the same number of ratings points and how you allocate them amongst your players is up to you)
 League Structure with competitive leader boards


So there you have it, these are the plans we have in place moving forward. If the game is successful we will certainly start building the brand into a viable property, and the best way to do that is through story development. 
Please let us know you like or disagree with the plan.

Concerning developing new games like Hockey or Soccer, etc. All of you, the MFL community will let us know what you want, and that’s what we will build, providing there are funds to allow us to develop a new game.

notes.title: 10/19/2017 MFL STEAM UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi there! We've finally delivered another Steam update. And it has some major changes:

Game Speed

Based on your feedback we've added Game Speed setting. It makes game faster or slower by changing some global attributes. You can switch it before each match in Team Selection screen (press X - Game Settings). We need your help to figure out what option should be default. Please, try it out and fill our survey:

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/RNZ7Y28

Keyboard Support

Finally, MFL doesn't require a gamepad to play it. We've reworked all our UI and input system to add keyboard support. If you need help with keyboard bindings -  try use tutorial or go directly to the Keyboard Map screen. As always, your feedback on this feature is highly appreciated.

Other fixes and changes

 More drama in Team Selection screen
 Rain VFX
 Various camera fixes
 AI fixes (timeouts logic, field goal logic)
 Various season UI fixes (schedule screen mostly)
 Now you have 20 seconds in online game to manage roster - after that clocks continue ticking
 Fix pause timer in online mode
 It was possible to play mini game 2 times in one game. Not anymore
 Fixed smack talk phrases after dirty trick play
 And many more less interesting fixes...

notes.title: 10/5/2017 MFL STEAM UPDATE / CHANGE LIST
notes.content:
All the changes & fixes to the MFL Steam build on 10/5/2017. Huge thanks to our community for all the bug reporting and feedback to help us make the game better! THANK YOU!!!

Fixed (reported by community)

Consecutive bullshit penalties  
Player is fainting after he breaks a tackle  
Kill QB / Kill Referee don’t stop on Galaxy Chaos field 
Wrong mini-game VO if player dies because of land mine 
Kicker position on kickoff after penalty. Now he is always in the middle of the field
Dead players not having a tombstone 
The "Fake Kick Rollout" pass play doesn't bring up receiver icons 
Teams' ratings differ slightly between Play Now and Season/Playoffs 
Missing referee on a field 
PAT moving to the next quarter after half time, thus breaking kickoff 
Timeout can stop Kill QB / Kill Referee dirty trick 
Announcer says wrong line if defense calls an audible


Changes

Improved position synchronization in online game. Should be noticeable if ping <= 70
Various framerate optimizations
More game SFX
Improved Crowd SFX (react more & louder in the playoffs)
Buzz Saw / Spikes hazard delay – it doesn’t instantly pop-up
Depth of field for smack talk cinematics
Added collision to Mutant Worm - now he is dangerous
Allow injured players be on a field if nobody else left, that means you no longer can forfeit because of injured players
Added rock hazard
Various tutorial / UI fixes and improvements
Bench has new player categories
Grim Bay Attackers Roster updated
20+ Backer names added
Tweaks and polish on difficulty settings (playing on rough is a bit easier now)
Improvements to AI in final seconds of game (AI is smarter)
Video Capture / Screen blood and numbers removed from options


In Progress

Keyboard support
Online mode improvements
Less tutorial & tip messaging
Leaderboards
Onside Kick improvements
More hazards and weather effects
Team Tuning
Stat Tuning
Arena & Hazard polish
SFX Improvements
